svg.title: P026. Where each column comes from
svg.desc: OrderDetails columns stay blue, Products green and Category coral. Side-by-side source bands carry through both joins, including unmatched NULLs. Calculations from multiple tables use violet and name their inputs. Eight stages preserve the working rows until grouping creates the final five totals.
svg.text: 5 sale lines → 6 joined rows → 5 category totals

g.aria-label: Step 1. Start with three source tables
g.text: Line 1 points to product 10, which belongs to category 1, Drinks.

g.aria-label: 5 order lines → 5 rows · 4 original columns + 3 product columns
g.text: 5 order lines → 5 rows · 4 original columns + 3 product columns
Line 5 keeps blue product ID 999 and four units. Its green fields are NULL because the product lookup failed.

g.aria-label: Step 3. Append the Category columns and keep Stationery
g.text: Append the Category columns and keep Stationery

g.aria-label: 5 rows → 6 rows · 7 previous columns + 2 category columns
g.text: 5 rows → 6 rows · 7 previous columns + 2 category columns
Green category 99 has no match. The last row belongs to Stationery. All five sale lines remain.
Use the matched category name. A missing category with a known product is Unmapped. A missing product is Unknown product.

g.aria-label: Step 5. Append a value for each line
g.text: Append a value for each line
Order 100 contains two Drinks lines. Their individual values are 10 × 2 = 20 and 8 × 1 = 8.

g.aria-label: Step 6. Trace one measure across the selected category’s rows
g.text: Trace one measure across the selected category’s rows

g.aria-label: The same 6 rows and 11 columns · Drinks highlighted for the four checks below
g.text: The same 6 rows and 11 columns · Drinks highlighted for the four checks below
Drinks · trace the inputs on lines 1 and 2
Zero real sale lines give Stationery a value of 0. An actual sale whose price is missing leaves Unknown product’s value NULL.

g.aria-label: Step 7. Collapse six joined rows into five groups
g.text: Collapse six joined rows into five groups

g.aria-label: 6 joined rows → 5 groups · one row per category
g.text: 6 joined rows → 5 groups · one row per category
The two Drinks lines form one group. The NULL category IDs for Unmapped and Unknown product stay separate because their labels differ.

g.aria-label: Step 8. Sort the same five results
g.text: descending, NULL last. Break ties by

g.aria-label: 5 groups → 5 sorted results · the same four output columns
g.text: 5 groups → 5 sorted results · the same four output columns
Sorting only changes the order. The original five sale lines contain 11 units, and the final report still contains all 11.
